title: Five new builder tools landed in the app catalog
summary:
A community-heavy day: five new BYOP developer tools, clearer account views, and a leaner way to check whether models are awake.

The build gained a small developer-tool shelf: Regexly turns plain English into explainable regexes, Codeverter translates code across 9+ languages, SQLCraft writes dialect-specific SQL, TestMine drafts unit tests, and ApiScribe sketches REST or GraphQL contracts. The blank page remains undefeated, but it now has more opponents.

Account identity and wallet status are now shared across Enter and app menus, with dashboard-linked avatars, display-name-first labels, live key and account Pollen details, and refreshes after permissions or wallet actions. Activity pages also handle quiet periods more cleanly with stable empty charts, fewer irrelevant filters, and simpler day-based navigation.

Model uptime moved out of the catalog and into a raw, edge-cached `/models/status` endpoint. Built-in clients, the website, and Enter now share the same health logic, while `/models` no longer repeatedly drags a 24-hour status query through the garden.

highlights.title: Describe it, get code
highlights.text: [Try Regexly](https://fadyabohamza-netizen.github.io/regexly) for regex with flavor-specific explanations, [Try SQLCraft](https://fadyabohamza-netizen.github.io/sqlcraft) for database queries, or [Try Codeverter](https://fadyabohamza-netizen.github.io/codeverter) to translate between programming languages.

highlights.title: Tests and API blueprints
highlights.text: Paste source code into [TestMine](https://fadyabohamza-netizen.github.io/testmine) to generate unit tests, or describe an API to [ApiScribe](https://fadyabohamza-netizen.github.io/apiscribe) for REST or GraphQL endpoint blueprints.

highlights.title: A clearer account menu
highlights.text: See your display name and current key and account Pollen status together in the updated account and app menus. [Open Enter](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys).

highlights.title: Model health, separate from models
highlights.text: Check model health at [`/models/status`](https://gen.pollinations.ai/models/status). Health data has moved out of `/models`, so model listings and status checks now have separate endpoints.
